HOW IT WORKS

One box for yourself. A stack for the group.

Each person puts their phone into their own RECLAIM box. Use it solo, or stack boxes during a shared session. Longer sessions earn more points; group participation earns an additional bonus.

Portfolio prototype · Hardware connectivity, participants and rewards are simulated. Physical product shown is a concept render.
